newsitem.title: ITALY: Edison, Gazprom completes pipeline study.
newsitem.headline: Edison, Gazprom completes pipeline study.

text.p: Italian energy group Edison and Russia's natural gas group RAO Gazprom have completed a feasibility study for building a gas pipeline from Russia to Italy, and both parties confirmed their interest in going head with the project.
A joint statement from the two groups said that their joint venture Volta had completed the pipeline feasibility study to import and distribute natural gas into Italy.
The project is to complete a 1,600 km pipeline from Russia to Italy, some of which is already built. Around 1,000 km still needs to be constructed to bring Russian gas to Italy.

The aim of the project is to import 10 billion cubic metres of natural gas per year, accounting for nearly one fifth of Italy's 55 billion cubic metre annual consumption. The feasibility study estimates Italy's gas needs to grow to 85 billion cubic metres by the year 2005.
Under the original plan, the pipeline would be completed and begin operations in 1999.
